lines.1: 「You want to know why I look after Leo so much?」
lines.5: 「Yes. His first instinct is to run away.」
lines.6: 「That's exactly why I intend to train him. He's not a bad person at heart.」
lines.7: 「I know he isn't a bad person.」
lines.8: 「But I don't see the point in training someone whose basic character is hopeless. The foundation itself is rotten.」
lines.9: 「I don't think Tsushima is worth the trouble of you personally looking after him. He has no potential.」
lines.10: 「I will never refuse to train someone simply because I think they have no potential.」
lines.11: 「As long as a person is alive, their possibilities are limitless.」
lines.12: 「If someone is willing to work hard, I'll support them.」
lines.13: 「B-but he's the sort of person who says irritating things like how he won't be swept away by the mood.」
lines.14: 「True. He did seem strangely attached to that phrase.」
lines.16: 「You seem to know quite a lot about Leo.」
lines.17: 「...We went to the same middle school.」
lines.19: 「If something happened between you, tell me about it.」
lines.20: 「Ah, no... It's fine! Really, it's fine!」
lines.21: 「Th-then I'll be going. I'm sorry for taking up your time!」
lines.23: 「What exactly was she trying to say?」
